name: Synth Pad — Drone
_doc: Pure synthetic pad — full-spectrum pink noise with slow, gentle modulation. Not naturalistic; reads as 'background hum' or 'spacecraft cabin'. For users who want noise cover without ANY associative content (no water, no wind, no birds).
_pairs_with: Anything. The pink-noise spectrum covers all the bands the canceller leaves residual in. Most useful when the user is concentrating (writing, reading) and finds naturalistic scenes distracting.

layers.name: pad
layers._doc: Pink noise, full-spectrum (20 Hz - 18 kHz). Long crossfades + slow rate randomization create a sense of gentle motion without obvious loops. The single layer is intentional — synth_pad's point is 'as little structure as possible'.

states.name: ambient
states._doc: Only one state. There's no narrative arc to synthesize — synth_pad's value is constancy.

description: Lush pink-noise pads with a slow chorus drift. Good for focus or sleep.
